title: Implement Automatic HTTPS Redirect
description: This feature matters as it ensures users are always accessing the application securely, redirecting HTTP requests to HTTPS. It improves security and performance by reducing the risk of data interception and eavesdropping. The feature will automatically redirect incoming HTTP requests to their HTTPS equivalents
testCases: Test HTTPS request is not redirected
acceptance: The feature is accepted when all HTTP requests are successfully redirected to HTTPS without any errors or warnings, and HTTPS requests are not redirected
reason: Implementing automatic HTTPS redirect is a high-impact feature that enhances the security and performance of the yantraverse framework, aligning with its focus on stability and production readiness
